purpose: Teach: 給油/特許庁/細分/折り返し/見込ん/配合/多角/個展

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員、給油代、本気で、節約するよう、皆様、ご協力、お願いいたします、絶対、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Everyone, I'd really appreciate your cooperation on cutting fuel costs. It would genuinely mean a lot.
lines.style: Formal, measured announcement. Slight pause after 'Everyone'—setting the weight of the request. Steady, businesslike pace. A softer landing on the gratitude at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、特許庁、本気で、登録、進めてまいります、絶対、保護、必要ですね、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with registering the new product at the patent office with full seriousness. Protection is absolutely necessary.
lines.style: Responsive and assured. Slight lean forward on 'we'll move forward'—showing commitment. Steady, professional pace. Emphasis on 'absolutely necessary' to show he understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: タスク、細分化して、社員、本気で、把握しやすくしましょうね、絶対、効率化、急務よ、本当に。
lines.en: Let's break down the tasks so the team can grasp them more easily. Efficiency is urgent right now.
lines.style: Clear, direct leadership voice. Brisk opening on 'Let's break down'—purposeful. Even tempo. Light emphasis on 'urgent' to convey importance without urgency in tone. Organized, not flustered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お問い合わせ、折り返しの体制、本気で、強化、進めてまいります、絶対、お客様、本当に、満足。
lines.en: Yes. We're strengthening our response system for customer inquiries and callbacks. I want to keep customer satisfaction high.
lines.style: Steady and determined. Confident on the opening 'yes.' Even pacing throughout. Slight warmth on 'customer satisfaction'—showing it's not just procedure but genuine care.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 若手の可能性、本気で、見込んでいきましょうね、絶対、人材、本当に、当社の財産よ、皆、頑張って欲しい。
lines.en: Let's really invest in the potential of our younger staff. They're genuinely our company's greatest asset. I want everyone to give their best.
lines.style: Sincere and encouraging. Warm opening on 'invest'—not corporate-flat. Slight soften on 'greatest asset,' then lift slightly at the end. Personal investment audible, not just management-speak.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の調味料の配合、本気で、研究、続けてまいります、絶対、お客様、好評、続けたいです。
lines.en: Yes. We'll continue our research on the new seasoning blend. I want to keep building on the positive response we're getting from customers.
lines.style: Engaged and forward-looking. Clear 'yes' that shows he's heard. Steady, confident pace. Brightening slightly on 'positive response'—genuine pleasure in the work, not just reporting.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、多角化、戦略的に、進めましょうね、本気で、新規事業、本当に、楽しみよ、皆、頑張ろうね。
lines.en: Let's advance our diversification strategy thoughtfully. I'm really excited about the new business ventures ahead. Everyone, let's do this together.
lines.style: Energized but grounded leadership. Slight lift on 'excited' without losing authority. Even, purposeful pace. Warmth at the close—'let's do this together'—inviting, not commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、芸術好きの方の個展、社内、本気で、応援していきたいですね、絶対、本当に、嬉しいです、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I'd love to support our staff member's solo art exhibition internally. It really does make me happy to see that kind of passion.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Eager on 'I'd love to support'—authentic enthusiasm. Gentle pace. Brightening visibly at 'passion'—this is a moment of real joy for him, not procedural approval.
